deadline.value: December 15, 2026, 8:59 PM Pacific for Fall 2027; application should be complete incl. letters
deadline.quote: The application deadline for Fall 2027 admission to the Berkeley Physics Ph.D. program is: December 15 2026, at 8:59 PM (Pacific Standard Time)/11:59 PM (Eastern Standard Time)

gre_subject.value: Physics GRE REQUIRED for Fall 2027 entry
gre_subject.quote: For the upcoming admissions cycle (applying in Fall 2026 for Fall 2027 entry): The Physics GRE is required

funding.value: Not stated on the admissions page checked

entry_route.value: Not stated on the page checked

fee_waiver.value: Graduate Division waivers are for U.S. citizens/permanent residents
fee_waiver.quote: U.S. citizens or current permanent residents may be eligible for an application fee waiver.

gre_general.value: Strongly recommended (not required) for Fall 2027; required from Fall 2028 entry
gre_general.quote: For the upcoming admissions cycle (applying in Fall 2026 for Fall 2027 entry): The Physics GRE is required, and the General GRE is strongly recommended but not required. | For future cycles (applying in Fall 2027 for Fall 2028 entry and beyond): Both the General and Physics GRE will be required.

toefl_min.value: TOEFL 90 (tests Jun 1, 2025-Jan 20, 2026) or 5 on the new scale with 4.5 Speaking/Writing; Duolingo not accepted
toefl_min.quote: Tests taken from June 1, 2025 to January 20, 2026: 90 minimum total score Tests taken on or after January 21, 2026: 5 minimum total score, with 4.5 minimum Speaking and Writ

english_waiver.value: Exemption depends on the country of your bachelor's institution; India is not on Berkeley's exempt list (a U.S.-accredited institution abroad would qualify)
english_waiver.quote: Applicants who have completed a bachelor’s degree or equivalent in a country or region where English is not the primary language used in both daily life and academic instruction must submit official proof of English language proficiency, unless they qualify for a TOEFL/IELTS exemption.

notes: Review starts immediately after the deadline; late letters may not be reviewed. Fall grades are not added after December 15.
